caption: The drawing shows a lidded vessel or lamp with a rounded body and a small knob on top of the lid, colored in shades of brown, placed on a tall, ornate pedestal. The pedestal base has multiple geometric facets in alternating red, black, and tan colors. The central stem of the pedestal is bulbous and decorated with red and black dots on a tan background, continuing the geometric motif. The top of the pedestal, where the vessel sits, is round and features alternating dark blue and red segments bordered by tan. The pedestal is centered on a plain, off-white background, with the artist's name “Norman Henry Yeckley” written near the bottom right in small, black letters.
title: Baptismal Font and Stand
